definitions.explanation: A system of money in general use in a particular country or economic area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外国|がいこく}→外国：02868_gaikoku⟧{通貨|つうか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{両替|りょうがえ}する→両替：03680_ryougae⟧。
{通貨|つうか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{外国|がいこく}→外国：02868_gaikoku⟧{通貨|つうか} (foreign currency)
- {通貨|つうか}⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧ (currency crisis)
- ⟦{共通|きょうつう}→共通：02590_kyoutsuu⟧{通貨|つうか} (common currency)
- ⟦{仮想|かそう}→仮想：17756_kasou⟧{通貨|つうか} (virtual currency, cryptocurrency)
- ⟦{基軸|きじく}→基軸：noentry⟧{通貨|つうか} (key currency, reserve currency)

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{通過|つうか}→通過：03506_tsuuka⟧ (passage, passing through) - same reading, different meaning

- ⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧ (yen - Japanese currency)
